Amorphous Weapon.name: Amorphous Weapon
Amorphous Weapon.description: Drawing raw destructive force out of their chest, the caster forces it to coalesce around their hands, extending outwards in the shape of a weapon. Caster can instead choose to manifest this weapon and bind it to another target; allowing them to use the weapon. Changing the form of the weapon has no action cost. It can become any basic weapon; additionally, the wielder of the weapon gains 3 bonus martial points and 3 stacking ranks in every weapon specialization and combat style.

Cloudburst.name: Cloudburst
Cloudburst.description: All of the caster's strikes burst on impact sending out a wave of nimbus clouds. The clouds cover a 10' radius around those attacked and persist for the duration of the spell. Any target in a cloud, save for the caster, is considered susceptible to lightning. Additionally, any attacks directed against a target in a cloud have 1 + 2/F placed rolls. The target of the character's attacks take full damage, while all other targets within 10' of the bursts also take an equal amount of lightning damage; this may include the user. All targets struck by the AOE get a single AGI save to halve the damage.

Current.name: Current
Current.description: Caster manifests a stream of water in the air. The stream can be oriented any which way within the area so long as it is a straight line. The water in the current halves movement DVs, rid's affected targets of their movement action, and carries those within it 40'+ 10'/F, STR check to negate the loss of their movement action and the halving of their movement DV's. The caster can change the direction of the current as a swift action. The current itself does not move, only those within it. Individuals in the current may re-attempt the check as a swift action.

Cyclone.name: Cyclone
Cyclone.description: Caster weaves a cyclone of water and air that moves across the battlefield. The cyclone has a movement speed of 20'. The caster may command the cyclone to move as a swift action. The cyclone will continue moving in a direction until it receives commands to stop. Anyone caught in the cyclone receives 2 + 1/2F d6 blunt damage and is swept into the cyclone - losing their movement action while inside, AGI check to negate both effects. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action, immediately regaining their movement action upon breaking free.

Dispersal.name: Dispersal
Dispersal.description: Caster slams the ground - a wave of wind emanating outwards from the point of impact, blowing all targets 60' backwards, knocking them prone, and inflicting 6 + 1/F d12 blunt damage to them with a AGI or STR save (Target's choice) for half damage and to negate being knocked back and prone. 3d6 additional blunt damage may be taken if targets are knocked into a solid structure.

Eye of the Storm.name: Eye of the Storm
Eye of the Storm.description: In response to another character's movement action, the caster can imprison them behind raging winds causing them to lose their movement action this turn, their choice of an STR or AGI save to negate.

Gaseous Form.name: Gaseous Form
Gaseous Form.description: Caster's body and everything they are wearing/holding evaporates into a mist. The mist has 20' + 10'/F flight speed and can only be affected by area of effect abilities. The mist cannot make attacks or form the verbal/somatic components of spells.

Lightning Reflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
Lightning Reflexes.description: As a reaction to a target coming within melee reach of the caster, The caster may use up to 4 + 1/F of their own MP to make an attack against them.

Lightning Whip.name: Lightning Whip
Lightning Whip.description: Caster produces a whip of pure lightning energy, pulling a target toward themselves by making a melee attack roll with (Rank*10)' reach.

Pulse.name: Pulse
Pulse.description: Caster electrifies a weapon increasing the reach or range of the weapon by 10', while also causing the first struck enemy to be knocked prone.

Static Charge.name: Static Charge
Static Charge.description: Caster supercharges their melee attacks this turn and the next. All the damage dealt to one target can jump LOS 40' to another target, HEA save to halve this damage and stop the static from jumping onto another target, repeating the effect. The chain repeats itself until the caster ends it, or the HEA save is successfully made; in all cases the lightning cannot jump back to targets that have already been struck.

Storm.name: Storm
Storm.description: A storm forms overhead. Torrential rain pours onto everyone in the area, limiting LOS to 20'. Immediately, and then all rounds afterwards using their swift action, the caster can direct a torrent of elemental energy from the storm at any target within its radius, making a ranged attack roll and inflicting 4+ 1/2F d12 lightning damage on hit.

Stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
Stormcaller.description: Caster reaches out to 4 + 1/F targets, taunting them with a display of power, forcing them to use their movement action to move towards the caster in a non-suicidal manner on each of their turns, WIL save to negate. If they are right next to the caster, they must stay as close as they can. Affected targets can re-attempt with a core action.

Tempest.name: Tempest
Tempest.description: Caster becomes a furious conduit of tempestuous power, gaining the ability to cast any Rank 0 spell as a swift action or reaction. They also gain the ability to dodge and nullify a singular attack roll made against the caster as a reaction. After dodging an attack roll, the caster can immediately choose to make a strike using up to 4 martial points against the original attacker, should they be within reach/range.

Unhittable.name: Unhittable
Unhittable.description: Caster surrounds themselves with tempestuous energy and turns away attacks with impeccable accuracy. After an attack roll is made against them, the caster rolls a d6. Should the roll be 4 or above, the attack misses, even if it were to otherwise hit.

Uplift.name: Uplift
Uplift.description: A whirlwind of air violently pushes targets inside the area 10' upward. So long as targets remain within the area, they have two displaced rolls on all AGI checks/saves and are slowed.

Zap.name: Zap
Zap.description: Caster teleports LOS 10' + 5'/F inflicting 1 + 1/2F d10 lightning damage to all targets within 5' of the caster upon arrival.

Vortex.name: Vortex
Vortex.description: Caster crafts a 70' tall vortex with a move speed of 60', though it disperses if it leaves the LOS. If the caster does not direct the vortex it remains stationary. If the vortex hits a target they must make an AGI or STR save (their choice). If failed, they are flung to the top and carried with the vortex, falling at the start of their turn. Falling will typically cause targets to take 7d6 blunt damage. If cast centered on themselves, the caster may ride the vortex to the top, staying there. The caster can control the vortex's movement utilizing their Swift Action.
